# Isaiah Chapter 7 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 25 verses]*

*Syro-Ephraimite crisis; Ahaz's faithlessness; Immanuel sign; coming devastation*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 7 (The Sign of Immanuel) addresses syro-ephraimite crisis; ahaz's faithlessness; immanuel sign; coming devastation. The key verse — "The virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
